This is a paper-derived GSLE implementation, not an official GSLE release.

GSGen: https://github.com/gsgen3d/gsgen
Compactness surface-distance and gap-filling formulas adapted in object_model.py.
Copyright (c) 2023 gsgen3d. MIT license: LICENSE.GSGen.

DreamGaussian: https://github.com/dreamgaussian/dreamgaussian
Stable Zero123 pipeline/guidance imported from the pinned source checkout.
Copyright (c) 2023 dreamgaussian. MIT license: LICENSE.DreamGaussian.

LangSplat: https://github.com/minghanqin/LangSplat
Official scene autoencoder, multiscale SAM/OpenCLIP extraction, feature rasterizer
and 3D language-field training. lang_nms.py vectorizes its original NMS formulas;
train_autoencoder.py preserves its architecture, optimizer, loss and schedule.
See LICENSE.LangSplat and the upstream files' notices. Its 3DGS components retain
the original Inria/MPII research/non-commercial license.

Segment Anything: https://github.com/facebookresearch/segment-anything
The LangSplat fork is pinned in upstream.json. sam_regions.py adapts the original
region cleanup implementation to an ordered thread pool, with equivalence checks.
Copyright (c) Meta Platforms, Inc. and affiliates. Apache2.0: LICENSE.SAM.

Original 3DGS renderer and camera utilities are imported from the already pinned
graphdeco-inria/gaussian-splatting checkout. Keep that repository's LICENSE.md.
Pretrained models keep their upstream model licenses; they are downloaded to the
ignored model cache, not redistributed in this source repository.

threestudio: https://github.com/threestudio-project/threestudio
Random camera distributions follow the paper-era source revision recorded in
camera_source.json. camera_sampling.py independently implements these sampling
equations in the existing COLMAP/object frame; threestudio is not a dependency.
